tmdb.overview: An emotional thrill ride through the day-to-day chaos of the city's most explosive hospital and the courageous team of doctors who hold it together. They will tackle unique new cases inspired by topical events, forging fiery relationships in the pulse-pounding pandemonium of the emergency room.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Inside the high-stakes emergency department of Chicago’s top hospital, a team of doctors and nurses faces intense medical cases while navigating complex emotions and ethical dilemmas. The adrenaline never stops — and neither does the pressure.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: As the hospital expands its reach, tensions rise between departments. Personal struggles, bureaucratic red tape, and moral challenges test the resolve of every staff member working to save lives.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: New leadership and shifting dynamics complicate the day-to-day operations of Gaffney Medical. While the staff strives to maintain compassion in the face of chaos, the boundaries between personal and professional lives continue to blur.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Romance, rivalry, and unexpected alliances stir within the ER. As medical technology and politics collide, the team must fight to put patients first — even when the system works against them.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Trauma strikes both inside and outside the hospital walls. As lives hang in the balance, the staff must rely on each other more than ever, all while facing the emotional toll of the job.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Staff changes and strained relationships shift the foundation of the ER. As high-stakes cases unfold, the hospital becomes a battleground of ambition, compassion, and survival.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Familiar faces return while new ones shake up the status quo. With every diagnosis, a deeper story unfolds — and the line between healing and hurting grows thinner.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: Medical breakthroughs, personal reckoning, and career-defining choices drive the staff of Gaffney Medical. The stakes have never been higher — in surgery, in love, and in life.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: Medical breakthroughs, personal reckoning, and career-defining choices drive the staff of Gaffney Medical. The stakes have never been higher — in surgery, in love, and in life.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: A mass casualty crisis shakes Gaffney Medical to its core. New doctors bring change, while personal and professional tensions test the team’s resolve in an ever-evolving ER.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: In Season 11, Dr. Hannah Asher and Dr. Dean Archer navigate parenthood and an evolving relationship after discovering Archer is the father of her child. Meanwhile, the Gaffney medical staff faces severe crises, including a massive prison riot lockdown and dangerous house fires, while Goodwin battles boardroom politics and her ex-husband's worsening dementia. The E.D. staff faces unrelenting high-stress events. An all-night rave turns to tragedy, and a massive prison riot plunges the hospital into chaos, forcing the doctors to operate in unconventional spaces. Goodwin's job is put in jeopardy when she confronts Rabari's manipulation and clashes with Abrams over hospital staffing changes.

results.overview:
Strangers is a 1978–82 ITV police procedural created and principally written by Murray Smith, based on characters created by Kenneth Royce in his novel series and subsequent 1977–78 television adaptation The XYY Man. Don Henderson and Dennis Blanch reprise their roles, respectively, of Detective Sergeant (DS) George Bulman and Detective Constable (DC) Derek Willis.

A group of police officers are brought together from across the country to the north of England. There, the fact that they're not well-known gives them the advantage to infiltrate where a more familiar local detective could not.

Despite being based around a comparatively small team of detectives, a regular feature in its early years is that few episodes feature the entire team, with most using just two or three regulars in any major role.
results.name: Strangers

results.overview: Gabriel's Fire is an American television series that ran on ABC in the USA in 1990–1991. A revamped version of the series, entitled Pros and Cons, aired briefly the following season.
results.name: Gabriel's Fire

results.overview: The plot follows a Black lawyer and favela resident who gets involved with organized crime.
results.name: Verônica com K

results.overview: Rafferty is an American medical drama that aired on CBS from September 5 to November 28, 1977. The series stars Patrick McGoohan as Doctor Sid Rafferty, a former army doctor running his own private practice in Los Angeles and helping out part time at City General Hospital.
results.name: Rafferty

results.overview: A year after the death of his friend and partner Sherlock Holmes at the hands of Moriarty, Dr. John Watson resumes his medical career as the head of a clinic dedicated to treating rare disorders. However, he soon finds that his old life is not done with him yet.
results.name: Watson

results.overview: Set in a large hospital, this moving human drama depicts the conflicts and struggles of two young doctors as they face their patients with conviction and passion.  Kazuma Asou, who helps out in his friend's clinic, is a doctor enjoying a peaceful life on rural Ishigaki Island. However, his father's death causes him to move to Tokyo and he starts working for a big hospital where he meets his old rival from his amateur boxing days, surgeon Kanzaki. Memories of their past return, and Asou finds himself once again competing with his popular counterpart. Their rivalry is further exacerbated by the two men's wildly different personalities, and it begins to involve the other doctors and nurses.
results.name: THE DOCTOR

results.overview: The 4077th Mobile Army Surgical Hospital is stuck in the middle of the Korean war. With little help from the circumstances they find themselves in, they are forced to make their own fun. Fond of practical jokes and revenge, the doctors, nurses, administrators, and soldiers often find ways of making wartime life bearable.
results.name: M*A*S*H

results.overview: The adventures of Joanna Beauchamp and her two adult daughters Freya and Ingrid -- both of whom unknowingly are their family's next generation of witches -- who lead seemingly quiet, uneventful modern day lives in Long Island's secluded seaside town of East Haven. When Freya becomes engaged to a young, wealthy newcomer, a series of events forces Joanna to admit to her daughters they are, in fact, powerful and immortal witches.
results.name: Witches of East End

results.overview: April, an aspiring journalist, is balancing her ambitious career with her family and a new office romance. In an unexpected twist of fate, April learns that she has leukemia.
results.name: Chasing Life

results.overview: The stories of the men and women who work the overnight shift at San Antonio Memorial Hospital. They are an irreverent and special breed, particularly adrenaline junkie T.C. Callahan.
results.name: The Night Shift

results.overview: Doctor Henry Morgan, New York City’s star medical examiner, has a secret. He doesn't just study the dead to solve criminal cases, he does it to solve the mystery that has eluded him for 200 years—the answer to his own inexplicable immortality. This long life has given Henry remarkable observation skills which impresses his new partner, Detective Jo Martinez. Each week, a new case and their budding friendship will reveal layers of Henry’s long and colorful past. Only his best friend and confidant, Abe knows Henry’s secret.
results.name: Forever

results.overview: Over a thirteen year period, a seemingly mild‐mannered male nurse, Malcolm Webster, set about poisoning and murdering his first wife, attempting to do the same to his second wife and moving on to a further scheme to deceive his third fiancée.
results.name: The Widower

results.overview: A heroic group of teens sheltered from the dangers of the post-apocalyptic world receive a message that inspires them to leave the safety of the only home they have ever known and embark on a cross-country journey to find the one man who can possibly save the world.
results.name: The Walking Dead: World Beyond

results.overview: The Fugitive Task Force relentlessly tracks and captures the notorious criminals on the Bureau's Most Wanted list. Seasoned agents oversee the highly skilled team that functions as a mobile undercover unit that is always out in the field, pursuing those who are most desperate to elude justice.
results.name: FBI: Most Wanted

results.overview: A Turkish mortician in his 30s, Baki is an introverted man content with his isolation from society. However, when he comes up against death at close range, a troubling question strikes him: who would wash his body after he dies? This realization pushes him to venture out into the world, hoping to connect with people and perhaps even find a spouse. Yet, his life-changing decision proves difficult to go through with, leading to a series of awkwardly humorous and sometimes bizarre situations.
results.name: The Late Offices

results.overview: A one-episode television pilot for a proposed 1981 spin-off of the British science fiction television series Doctor Who. It features former series regulars Sarah Jane Smith, an investigative journalist played by Elisabeth Sladen, and K9, a robotic dog voiced by John Leeson. Both characters had been companions of the Fourth Doctor but they had not appeared together before. The single episode, A Girl's Best Friend was broadcast by BBC1 as a Christmas special on 28 December 1981 but was not taken up for a continuing series.
results.name: K-9 and Company

results.name: Trapper John, M.D.
